name: Frostfang Pass
opening: An avalanche roars down behind you and seals the road home. Ahead, the mountain pass is silent, except for a thin line of smoke curling out of a cave.
picture: a snowy mountain pass at pink dawn, a narrow trail leading to a cave with smoke curling out
beats: Survive the cold and reach the cave
Meet whoever lives in the smoking cave
Find another way down the mountain
style: icy white snow, cold dawn pink
secret: A young dragon lives in the cave, and it is more scared of you than you are of it.
